english.title: Aggravated delivery of false document / making of false statement to registrar re registration of overseas entity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[delivered or caused to be delivered to the registrar of companies for England and Wales, for the purposes of Part 1 of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022, a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..),]_
(B)_[made to the registrar of companies for England and Wales, for the purposes of Part 1 of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022, a statement namely, **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT..)]_

knowing that it was misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to section 32(1), (2) and (4) of the Economic Crime (Transparency andEnforcement) Act 2022.

english.notes: This offence document should not be used after the 3rd March 2024 due to changes made by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023. For offences applying from the 4th March 2024, see H101612 (basic) and H101613 (aggravated).

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine. Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction increased from 2nd May 2022. This applies only to offences committed on or after that date. For offences committed before 2nd May 2022 the maximum penalty on summary conviction is six months.
